# Lockfile Format (`zpm.lock`)

## Purpose
Record the exact resolved versions of every transitive dependency so builds are
reproducible.

## Schema
```toml
# This file is automatically generated by zpm. Do not edit.
version = 1

[[package]]
name = "serde"
version = "1.0.188"
source = "registry+https://zpm.example.com"
checksum = "sha256:abc123..."

[[package.dependencies]]
name = "itoa"
version = "1.0.9"
